title: Auth-Service Connection Pool Exhaustion & Upstream Timeout Recovery

incident_context.summary: During high throughput periods or following a bad release tag deployment, the auth-service connection pool saturates, triggering cascading HTTP 503 Service Unavailable errors across api-gateway-01 instances.
incident_context.architecture_overview: Clients connect via Envoy/Nginx api-gateway-01 proxies which dispatch bearer token validation requests over connection pools to the internal auth-service deployment in Kubernetes namespace 'core-services'.

known_symptoms: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable spikes on api-gateway-01
Syslog warnings: '[WARN] Connection pool reaching capacity' followed by '[ERROR] HTTP 503 Service Unavailable - upstream auth-service timeout'
Gateway-proxy main process failure or high egress latency (>5000ms)
Auth-service pod restarts or readiness probe failures

diagnostics.description: Inspect gateway proxy syslogs for timeout patterns
Verify auth-service pod status and rollout history in Kubernetes

remediation_steps.description: Revert the auth-service deployment to the previous stable revision tag.

remediation_steps.action: Restart Gateway Proxy Service if process crashed
remediation_steps.description: Ensure gateway proxy restarts with clean connection pool allocations.
Confirm all replaced pods transition to 1/1 Running state.
